fields.meaning: Unique identifier assigned to the candidate within the Hays system
fields.source_hints: Table label: Candidate, Appears in top-left of document

fields.meaning: Target job title or role the candidate is seeking
fields.source_hints: Table label: Position Required, Blank value cell indicates user input

fields.meaning: Recruiter's expert assessment and commentary on the candidate's suitability, strengths, and context
fields.source_hints: Under heading: Our expert opinion, Appears as bulleted or paragraph text

fields.meaning: List of professional certifications, checks, or qualifications held by the candidate
fields.source_hints: Under heading: Professional qualifications, Bounded by «TableStart:bCheckType» and «TableEnd:bCheckType», Repeating row with field «CheckType»

fields.meaning: Candidate's current notice period required to leave their job
fields.source_hints: Table label: Notice period, Appears in both top and middle sections

fields.meaning: Candidate's current town or location of residence
fields.source_hints: Table label: Living in, Appears in both top and middle sections

fields.meaning: Candidate's desired or expected salary range or figure
fields.source_hints: Table label: Salary required, Preceded by £ symbol in layout

fields.meaning: Name of the Hays recruitment consultant presenting the candidate profile
Job title of the Hays recruitment consultant (e.g., Recruitment Consultant, Talent Partner)
Area of recruitment specialization for the Hays consultant (e.g., IT, Finance, Engineering)
fields.source_hints: Marker: «EmployeeSpecialistArea», No context snippet, likely in footer or branding area

fields.meaning: Telephone number of the Hays recruitment consultant
Email address of the Hays recruitment consultant
fields.source_hints: Marker: «EmployeeEmail», Appears in contact block with 'E:' prefix

fields.meaning: Candidate resume value for 'Candidate Full Name'.
fields.source_hints: Extract resume facts matching label or marker 'Candidate Full Name'., Render by replacing exact marker '«CandidateFullName»'.
Extract resume facts matching label or marker 'Check Type'., Render by replacing exact marker '«CheckType»'.

fields.meaning: Value for the template label 'Position Required'.
fields.source_hints: Fill from resume data matching the adjacent table label 'Position Required'., Injection target is the blank value cell immediately after this label.

fields.meaning: Rich resume content intended for the 'Key skills' section.
fields.source_hints: Extract relevant resume paragraphs for section 'Key skills'., Injection target is the body of the section under this heading.

fields.meaning: Value for the template label 'Position Required'.

instruction_blocks: Paste the candidate’s own CV in this space and please delete these instructions before finalising the document.

Alternatively, if you want to create a new CV for the candidate in a fully Hays branded format, then locate the Candidate CV template held here http://haysnet.hays.loc/uk/Pages/Default.aspx. Highlight all of the content in that template and copy it. Then highlight all of this red text and the heading of this page ‘Candidate’s own CV’ and press delete. Then paste the content from the other template
